children: The Philippines' agriculture ministry said on Monday it has imposed a 60-day restriction on pork imports to protect the local industry.
Local producers had lost 27.9 billion pesos ($441.25 million) in the first seven months of the year, it said in a statement
"The preliminary findings show that the surge in pork imports is putting severe pressure on our local producers," said agriculture minister, Francisco Tiu Laurel.
